explanation: At D1 and GO it is always high, about 9-10 (GO is 10 after choosing a1 and about 9 after a2; D1 slips to 8 late in the episode, after about trial 80), whatever the reward. At D2 it depends on the state reached and the choice made: about 8 for a1 reaching S2 (rare), about 5 for a2 reaching S2 (common), about 3 for a1 reaching S1 (common, dropping to 1-2 after about trial 80), and 0-1 for a2 reaching S1 (rare).
